title: Synthetic-Data-Generator-for-Structured-Databases
summary: A Streamlit application that connects to SQLite or PostgreSQL databases, profiles their schema and data, and generates synthetic tables with configurable constraints and differential privacy noise. It directly runs SDV's TabularPreset/CTGAN single-table synthesizers and HMASynthesizer for relational data as the core data generation engine.
evidence: app.py:126-134 uses MultiTableMetadata + HMASynthesizer.fit/sample; app.py:9-10 imports sdv.lite.TabularPreset and sdv.single_table.CTGAN
